name: semver-xyz
description: The semver.xyz specification site and reference parser

scripts.deploy: vlt run build -w site && vlt run deploy:site
scripts.deploy:site: wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name semver-xyz --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: vlt run build -w site && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name semver-xyz --branch preview --commit-dirty=true
scripts.bench: vlt run bench -w libraries/javascript && cd libraries/rust && cargo bench --bench compare && cd ../.. && node benchmarks/report.mjs
scripts.release: vlt run test -w libraries/javascript && vlt publish --workspace libraries/javascript --access public
